notes: FY end Aug 31. Latest reported quarter = Q3 FY2026 (ended 2026-05-31); last completed FY = FY2025 (ended 2025-08-31). Stock crashed ~18% on 2026-06-18 after Q3 print and now ~$124.83 (down ~56% over 52 weeks; near 52w low $125.60). PRICE/VALUATION: ATH closing $386.21 (2025-02-05); 52w high $307.77. fwd_pe 8.67 from StockAnalysis uses NTM (~FY27) consensus; on current-FY adjusted guidance midpoint (~$13.84) the forward P/E is ~9.0x. fwd_pe_5y_avg ~25.5x is an aggregator-derived estimate (sources spanned ~25-26.5x); implied discount ~-66%. NET CASH: StockAnalysis shows cash $10.17B vs total debt $8.39B (incl. operating leases) => net cash ~$1.78B; SEC funded debt is only ~$5.14B so net cash on a funded-debt basis is closer to ~$5B (net_cash=true either way). nd_ebitda computed off EBITDA ~$12.94B. ROIC ~27% is an ESTIMATE (Accenture historically high-20s%; not disclosed in release). SBC: GAAP share-based comp ~$2.4-2.5B/yr (cash-flow statement) => ~3.5% of FY25 revenue and ~22-23% of FCF; ESTIMATED due to inconsistent aggregator figures (Macrotrends TTM $5.2B appears to conflate items). DROP CLASSIFICATION = mixed: Q3 BEAT adj EPS ($3.80 vs ~$3.72), expanded margin to 17.0%, and FY revenue guide was RAISED to 3-4% LC — arguing fear/de-rating; BUT new bookings fell 2-3%, organic/local-currency growth only +3%, and there are genuine concerns about GenAI disrupting the consulting model plus US federal spending drag — arguing some genuine deceleration. Net: valuation de-rating/rotation amplified by real but modest fundamental softening.
